hooks.command: Read 0 - System/_cache.md for recent context before answering.

Add a block at the TOP of 0 - System/_cache.md, under the header: '## Session YYYY-MM-DD' with what was done, which files were touched, and any open questions. Then run `python3 "0 - System/scripts/trim_cache.py" 2` to keep only the 2 most recent sessions; older ones are moved to _cache-archive.md.
